title: Allocation slider fails to load on mobile in two languages
description: An allocation slider fails to load on mobile in two languages, so people leave it blank

survey_behavior.question: Q7Sk
survey_behavior.error_message: Slider widget failed to load due to missing mobile localized resource; no input control visible.

reproduction_steps: Open survey with language=1046 or 2058 on mobile device; navigate to Q7Sk; slider input control does not render, allowing respondent to submit empty.

title: Straightlining on 7-item grid
description: A group of respondents give the same answer to all 7 items of a grid
reproduction_steps: Respondent quality issue: fraud/bot answers identical option down all items of T14 grid without reading.

title: Speeding cluster from one sample source
description: A cluster of very fast completions, all from one sample source
reproduction_steps: Sample panel issue: respondents from bgSource=3 complete interview in under 40% of median survey duration.

title: Numeric question accepts values above declared maximum

survey_behavior.question: S5
survey_behavior.validation_rule: Missing client-side upper limit check; permits inputs > 100.0 without triggering error message.

reproduction_steps: Navigate to S5; enter value 115.0; survey submits successfully without throwing validation error.

title: Allocation question does not enforce sum of 100
description: An allocation question lets people continue when the parts do not total 100

survey_behavior.question: Q7Mx
survey_behavior.validation_rule: Sum validation script disabled; allows next button click when sum != 100.

reproduction_steps: Navigate to Q7Mx; enter parts summing to 85; click next; page advances without error.

title: Routing skip logic bug routes disqualified respondents into question
description: A routing bug sends people into a question they should have skipped

expected_symptom.rule: If S2 == 1, skip Q9 and proceed directly to Q11
expected_symptom.violation: Respondents with S2 == 1 observed with non-empty Q9 responses.

survey_behavior.routing_fault: Condition evaluates inverted; sends S2=1 into Q9.

reproduction_steps: Set S2=1; click next; survey displays Q9 instead of skipping to Q11.

title: Pre-selected default option accepted by majority
description: One question has a pre-selected default, so most people accept it
reproduction_steps: Radio button for option 1 initialized checked by default on page load.

title: Screener over-rejection in specific market
description: The screener rejects far too many people in one market
reproduction_steps: Screen-out criteria in language 1046 market erroneously excludes high proportions of respondents.
